profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Dremio
profile.summary:
I am a software engineering leader with over 10 years of experience designing, developing, and delivering innovative solutions for business intelligence platforms. Core competencies include:

-Product Strategy: Pioneered monetization strategy and license enforcement system enabling new SaaS revenue stream for Tableau Prep.
-Technical Architecture: Designed secure AWS serverless authentication modules leveraging Lambda, DynamoDB, and other services to enhance scalability.
-Feature Development: Led engineering teams to deliver high-value features including row-level lineage, dynamic query parameters, and cloud connectivity.
-Cross-Team Collaboration: Partnered closely with product, security, and infrastructure teams to align on roadmaps and accelerate delivery.
-Impact and Results: Quantifiably improved authentication flows, slashed OAuth implementation time, unlocked major enterprise deals, and fulfilled numerous top customer feature requests.

positions.title: Lead Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
•	Led the design and development of the Source Row Number feature, fulfilling a top-3 Tableau Prep user request, allowing for leveraging of data provenance through the preservation of the original row order
•	Engineered a safe listing protocol for Tableau's pluggable connectors in Tableau Prep, enabling efficient integration of 12 new connectors and empowering users to create new custom ones effortlessly
•	Unlocked a major enterprise partnership with Walmart by building Linux system support for Windows AD shared storage integration in Prep Conductor
•	Played a pivotal role in developing Tableau Prep's top-requested feature by collaborating across 5 teams and delivering core backend infrastructure to enable automatic flow updates using Dynamic Parameters
positions.insights: Skills: Data Preparation · Linux · Front-End Development · React.js · OAuth · TypeScript · Backend

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Pioneered Tableau Prep's monetization strategy by collaborating with the enterprise licensing team to design an enforcement system, then led 6 engineers to implement it and enable licensed access and trials
•	Drove backend and OAuth development for cloud data connectivity in Tableau Prep, enabling access to 4 cloud-based data sources including Dropbox, while establishing the foundation to expand the connectors
•	Oversaw integration and implementation of 7 external team features by serving as subject matter expert on authentication and keychain management
•	Enhanced security and compliance of Tableau's OAuth authentication flow by migrating it from QTWebKit prompts to a QTWebEngine external browser-based sequence

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and built GALOP, a generic authentication serverless proxy, using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and other AWS technologies, reducing the connector OAuth development cycle by 50%
•	Enabled connectivity to cloud storage services including Box and OneDrive in Tableau, through developing reusable components for authentication, integration with the native data stack, and keychain handling
•	Implemented BQL querying in Tableau for BigQuery, eliminating reliance on a costly proprietary SQL translation driver. This defect-free feature served as the foundation for the future migration to GoogleSQL
•	Implemented variable and parameter support in Tableau, enabling dynamic parametrized queries through UI prompts on data sources like SAP HANA

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Researched and implemented a feature that allowed Tableau to connect to Google BigQuery using their SQL-like BigQuery Query Language(BQL), to no longer rely on a costly external proprietary driver that was used to convert standard SQL to BQL.The BQL feature had no defects discovered and served as foundation for an eventual smooth migration to GoogleSQL.
Presented the features to the Tableau execs and other teams at the end of the projects, and the features were shipped to customers shortly after.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Google Analytics · C++ · Debugging · Java · OAuth · Google BigQuery · Computer Science · SQL

•	Maintained MSSQL databases supporting Facturar en Linea and other invoicing systems, optimizing queries and performance tuning to enhance reliability and scalability across products
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Studio · Debugging · Invoicing · .NET Framework · Computer Science · SQL

projects.title: GALOP (Generic AWS Lambda-based OAuth Proxy)
projects.description:
GALOP is an OAuth 2.0 authentication service built on AWS serverless technologies. It authenticates Tableau users to data providers on-demand.

Key benefits:

-Isolates Tableau authentication code for easier maintenance.
-Allows updates without user intervention.
-Minimizes costs and risks compared to traditional hosting.
-Uses Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB for serverless execution.
-Developed in Node.js and JavaScript with the Serverless Framework.

Overall, GALOP streamlines Tableau authentication using a serverless approach for flexibility, isolation, and efficiency.
